evaluator_config.message_template: Module-level mutable state detected — use function-local or class-based state

rationale: Module-level mutable state is global state. It is shared across all callers, all threads, and all test runs. It creates invisible coupling between unrelated code paths and makes testing non-deterministic.
remediation: Use class-based state, dependency injection, or function-local state. Module-level constants (immutable values, frozen dataclasses) are permitted.
